0.0: You've done so well with your training, I don't think there's any question you deserve to be called the Great Protector. Would you like your trophy now?

no.0: Sure, just let me know when you want it.

yes.0: There it is...you are the Great Protector of Maple World. You've come a long way, but don't stop now! As monsters grow stronger, we must grow stronger as well, and you must lead the charge. Good luck, and stay strong!

default.0: You know, you really should have been working harder over the last 10 days.
